## Change and validation

Describe the behavior changed and the tests actually executed.

## Web interface evidence

For changes to `headless/web/`, all items below are required (otherwise mark N/A):

- [ ] Ran `scripts/screenshots.sh` successfully against the actual application.
- [ ] Committed real PNGs and the manifest under `docs/screenshots/`.
- [ ] Visually inspected every generated view at 320×240, 800×480 and 1440×900,
      including the bottom views of scrolling dialogs.
- [ ] Reported unsupported views and any remaining visual limitations.

Automated layout checks do not substitute for visual inspection.
